svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Two boards on one 42 × 78 cm sheet — 5.9 mm
svg.desc: 420 × 780 mm, 5.9 mm ply. Two whole boards, each one circle split in place, stacked — 768.644 mm of length. Around them, in the corners and the waist: two full sets of the 6 mm small parts (32 each — 28 ingredient tokens and 4 ship hulls), 3 mm apart. Units: mm. 23.35 mm squares, 5.9 mm material. KERF-COMPENSATED (every cut pushed 0.1375 mm off the kept wood) EXCEPT both boards' seams and the three sides of each Tortuga square, cut on their nominal line on purpose: one cut makes both faces. Cut each board's rim LAST. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
